name: hotel-order-follow
description: 酒店装修供应链在线跟单互助系统（方案A：miniapp 为用户端；admin-pc 为独立 PC 管理后台）

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,miniapp -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev:h5 --prefix miniapp"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n server,miniapp,admin -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev:h5 --prefix miniapp" "npm run dev --prefix admin-pc"
scripts.start: concurrently -n server,miniapp -c blue,green "npm run start --prefix server" "npm run dev:h5 --prefix miniapp"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix miniapp && npm install --prefix admin-pc
